messages.body: worker_status: succeeded. The brief guard passed (both command copies identical, with an Unattended mode section and a standalone --unattended). Nothing is staged or committed; the index also notes that VERSION (3.7) and package.json (4.1.7) disagree with pyproject (5.0.0). Running uv created an untracked .venv in this worktree.
